If no <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The update package ID, which is the unique identifier of the update package.

The update package ID is one of the response parameters returned when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html to create an update package.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html to view the update package ID from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
升级包ID，升级包的唯一标识符。

升级包ID是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建升级包时，返回的参数之一。

可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the update package belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The automatic retry interval after a device update fails. Unit: minutes. Valid values:

0: Retry immediately.
10: Retry after 10 minutes.
30: Retry after 30 minutes.
60: Retry after 60 minutes (1 hour).
1440: Retry after 1,440 minutes (24 hours).

<notice> The value of RetryInterval must be less than the value of TimeoutInMinutes. Examples:
If the value of TimeoutInMinutes is 60, the maximum value of RetryInterval is 30.
If the value of TimeoutInMinutes is 1440, the maximum value of RetryInterval is 60.

If you want to set RetryInterval to retry after 24 hours, we recommend that you do not specify TimeoutInMinutes. This is because no retry is triggered after an update times out.
</notice>

If you do not specify this parameter, no retry is performed
parameters.help_zh:
设备升级失败后，自动重试的时间间隔，单位为分钟。可选值：

0：立即重试。
10：10分钟后重试。
30：30分钟后重试。
60：60分钟（即1小时）后重试。
1440：1,440分钟（即24小时）后重试。

<notice> RetryInterval的值需要小于TimeoutInMinutes的值。例如：
TimeoutInMinutes的值为60分钟，RetryInterval的值最大可设置为30。
TimeoutInMinutes的值为1440分钟，RetryInterval的值最大可设置为60。

若RetryInterval需设置为24小时后重试，则建议不传入TimeoutInMinutes。因升级超时后，不会再触发升级重试。
</notice>

不传入此参数，则表示不重试
parameters.name: retry_interval

parameters.help_en:
The number of automatic retries.

If you specify RetryInterval, you must also specify this parameter.

Valid values:

1: 1 time.
2: 2 times.
5: 5 times
parameters.help_zh:
自动重试次数。

如果传入RetryInterval参数，则需传入该参数。

可选值：

1：1次。
2：2次。
5：5次
parameters.name: retry_count

parameters.help_en:
The update timeout period for the device. If the device does not complete the update within the specified period, the update fails. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1 to 1440.

The time is calculated from when the device first reports the update progress. If the device goes online and offline multiple times during the update, which triggers IoT Platform to push the update package multiple times, the start time is always the time when the device first reported the update progress.
If an update fails due to a timeout, IoT Platform does not trigger the automatic retry logic.

If you do not specify this parameter, no timeout limit is applied to the device update
parameters.help_zh:
设备升级超时时间，超过指定时间后，设备未完成升级，则升级失败。单位为分钟，取值范围为1~1,440。

从设备首次上报进度开始计算时间。升级期间若设备多次上下线，触发物联网平台多次推送升级包，都始终以设备最开始的第一次上报升级进度时间作为开始时间。
因超时而导致的升级失败，物联网平台不会触发自动重试逻辑。




不传入该参数，则表示设备升级没有超时限制
parameters.name: timeout_in_minutes

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of devices to which the update package download URL is pushed per minute. Valid values: 10 to 10000.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 10000 is used
parameters.help_zh:
每分钟最多向多少个设备推升级包下载URL。取值范围：10~10,000。

不传入该参数，则取默认值10,000
parameters.name: maximum_per_minute

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite previous update tasks. Valid values:

1 (default): Do not overwrite. If the device already has an update task, only the existing task is executed.
2: Overwrite. The device executes only the new update task. In this case, MultiModuleMode cannot be set to true.

Tasks that are being updated are not overwritten
parameters.help_zh:
是否覆盖之前的升级任务。取值：

1（默认）：不覆盖。若设备已有升级任务，则只执行已有任务。
2：覆盖。设备只执行新的升级任务。此时MultiModuleMode不能传入true。

不覆盖升级中的任务
parameters.name: overwrite_mode

parameters.help_en:
The dynamic update mode. Valid values:

1 (default): In addition to updating devices that currently meet the update conditions, the system continuously checks whether devices meet the update conditions and updates the devices that meet the conditions.

2: Takes effect only for devices that subsequently report new version numbers
parameters.help_zh:
动态升级模式。取值范围：

1（默认）：除了升级当前满足升级条件的设备，还将持续检查设备是否满足升级条件，对满足升级条件的设备进行升级。

2：仅对后续上报新版本号的设备生效
parameters.name: dynamic_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether IoT Platform actively pushes update tasks to devices. Valid values:

true (default): Yes. After the batch task is created, IoT Platform actively pushes over-the-air update task directly to online devices within over-the-air update scope.
    
    In this case, devices can still actively send requests to IoT Platform to obtain OTA update task information.

false: No. Devices must send requests to IoT Platform to obtain OTA update task information
parameters.help_zh:
物联网平台是否主动向设备推送升级任务。

true（默认）：是。批次任务创建完成后，物联网平台主动将升级任务，直接推送给升级范围内的在线设备。
    
    此时，设备仍可主动向物联网平台发起请求，来获取OTA升级任务信息。

false：否。设备必须通过向物联网平台发起请求，来获取OTA升级任务信息
parameters.name: need_push

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to manually control device OTA upgrades. You can configure this parameter to control whether a device can perform OTA upgrades by using a mobile app. You must develop the mobile app. Valid values:

false (default): No. The device obtains OTA upgrade task information directly based on the NeedPush settings.
true: Yes. The device cannot obtain the OTA upgrade task. The device can obtain OTA upgrade task information based on the NeedPush settings only after the OTA upgrade is confirmed on the app side
parameters.help_zh:
如需自主控制设备OTA升级时，可配置此参数，通过手机App来控制，设备是否可进行OTA升级。手机App需您自行开发。


false（默认）：否。直接按照NeedPush设置，获取OTA升级任务信息。
true：是。设备无法获取OTA升级任务，需App侧确认OTA升级后，才能按照NeedPush设置，获取OTA升级任务信息
parameters.name: need_confirm

parameters.help_en:
The group ID.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify GroupType, and you cannot specify SrcVersion.N.
If you do not specify this parameter, you do not need to specify GroupType, and you must specify SrcVersion.N.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html operation to query the group ID (GroupId)
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID。

如果传入该参数，则必须同时传入GroupType，且不能传入SrcVersion.N。
如果不传入该参数，则无需传入GroupType，且必须传入SrcVersion.N。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html接口查询分组ID（**GroupId**）
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The group type. The only valid value is LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC (dynamic group).

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify GroupId, and you cannot specify SrcVersion.N.
If you do not specify this parameter, you do not need to specify GroupId, and you must specify SrcVersion.N
parameters.help_zh:
分组类型，仅可取值LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC（动态分组）。

如果传入该参数，则必须同时传入GroupId，且不能传入SrcVersion.N。
如果不传入该参数，则无需传入GroupId，且必须传入SrcVersion.N
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The download protocol for over-the-air update package. Valid values: HTTPS (default) and MQTT. After the device receives over-the-air update package download information pushed by IoT Platform, it downloads over-the-air update package by using this protocol.

<notice>To use the MQTT protocol to download update packages, the following conditions must be met:
Supported regions: China (Shanghai), China (Beijing), and China (Shenzhen).
OTA update package: The package contains only one file, and the file size does not exceed 16 MB.
Device SDK: You must use the latest version of the C language Link SDK provided by IoT Platform to develop the OTA update and MQTT file download capabilities. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330985.html.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
升级包下载协议，可选：HTTPS（默认）或MQTT。设备端收到物联网平台推送的升级包下载信息后，通过该协议下载升级包。

<notice>使用MQTT协议下载升级包，必须符合以下条件：
支持的地域：仅中国的华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）和华南1（深圳）。
OTA升级包：仅包含一个文件，且文件大小不超过16 MB。
设备端SDK：必须使用物联网平台提供的C语言Link SDK最新版本的软件包，开发OTA升级和MQTT下载文件的能力。详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330985.html。

</notice>
parameters.name: download_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the device supports simultaneous multi-module upgrades. Valid values:

false (default): No. The device does not support simultaneous multi-module upgrades.
true: Yes. The device supports simultaneous multi-module upgrades. In this case, OverwriteMode cannot be set to 2. Upgrade nodes under the same module are overwritten, but nodes that are being upgraded are not overwritten.

<notice>
Supported instances: Enterprise instances and new public instances.
Device SDK: You must use the C language Link SDK V4.x provided by IoT Platform.
Initiate a group-based dynamic upgrade batch: The Settings of MultiModuleMode and OverwriteMode must be consistent with those in the existing dynamic upgrade batch corresponding to the group.

</notice>

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58328.html
parameters.help_zh:
设备是否支持多模块同时升级。

false（默认）：否，设备不支持多模块同时升级。
true：是，设备支持多模块同时升级。此时OverwriteMode不能传入2。相同模块下的升级任务会被覆盖，但不覆盖升级中的任务。

<notice>
支持的实例：企业版实例和新版公共实例。
设备端SDK：必须使用物联网平台提供的设备端C语言4.x版本的Link SDK。
发起基于分组的动态升级批次：MultiModuleMode和OverwriteMode的设置，必须与分组对应的存量动态升级批次中的设置保持一致。

</notice>

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58328.html
parameters.name: multi_module_mode

parameters.help_en:
The list of version numbers to be updated.

If you specify this parameter, you cannot specify GroupId and GroupType.
If you do not specify this parameter, you must specify GroupId and GroupType.

When you initiate a dynamic update task for a delta update package based on versions, the value of this parameter must be the same as the version number to be updated (SrcVersion) of the delta update package.
When you initiate a dynamic update task for a delta update package based on a dynamic group, you do not need to specify this parameter.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html to view the OTA module version number FirmwareVersion of the device.
The list cannot contain duplicate version numbers.
You can specify up to 10 version numbers
parameters.help_zh:
待升级版本号列表。

如果传入该参数，则不能传入GroupId和GroupType。
如果不传入该参数，则必须传入GroupId和GroupType。

基于版本对差分升级包发起动态升级任务时，该参数值必须与差分升级包的待升级版本号（SrcVersion）相同。
基于动态分组对差分升级包发起动态升级任务时，无需传入该参数。
可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html，查看设备OTA模块版本号**FirmwareVersion**。
列表中不能有重复的版本号。
最多可传入10个版本号
parameters.name: src_version

fields.help_en:
The key of the batch tag. The key can contain only letters, digits, and periods (.). It must be 1 to 30 characters in length. You can add up to 10 batch tags.

Batch tags are delivered to devices when update notifications are pushed to the devices.

Batch tags are optional. If the Required field is set to Yes, it indicates that if you specify batch tags, Tag.N.Value and Tag.N.Key must be specified in pairs
fields.help_zh:
批次标签key。仅支持英文字母、数字、半角句号（.），长度限制为1~30个字符。支持最多添加10个批次标签。

批次标签将在向设备推送升级通知时下发给设备。

批次标签可以不传入。是否必选的是，表示如果传入批次标签Tag，Tag.N.Value与Tag.N.Key必须成对传入
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the batch tag. The value must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. You can add up to 10 batch tags. The total length of all batch tag keys and values cannot exceed 4,096 characters.

Batch tags are optional. If the Required field is set to Yes, it indicates that if you specify batch tags, Tag.N.Value and Tag.N.Key must be specified in pairs
fields.help_zh:
批次标签value。长度限制为1~1024个字符。支持最多添加10个批次标签。所有批次标签key和vlaue的长度总和，不能超过4096个字符。


批次标签可以不传入。是否必选的是，表示如果传入批次标签Tag，Tag.N.Value与Tag.N.Key必须成对传入
fields.name: value
